title: 第58章遇到逃兵第57章前往钢铁城
lines: 三分钟时限到。
没有多余提示，没有休整拖延。
陆寻收回扶在林小满肩头的指尖，手臂自然垂落回身侧，肌理绷紧归位，所有松弛的状态瞬间清零。腰背旧伤的酸胀依旧持续拉扯，胸口十字徽章的低频灼麻稳稳盘踞胸腔，这片死地的能量压迫从未减弱，始终死死覆在众人躯体之上。他眼底沉黑一片，情绪彻底收敛，只剩刻板冷静的前行意志，唇瓣轻启，冷硬短句干脆落地。
“继续出发。”
话音落，脚步先动。
一行人再度踏入浓稠雾霭之中，队伍阵型依旧紧凑戒备，无一人松懈。林小满压下颅腔残留的钝痛，呼吸逐步回归浅促的平稳，精神感知网再度全面铺开，细碎的精神丝线穿透厚重雾层，筛查方圆百米的所有能量异动与生命气息。方才短暂的情绪崩塌彻底隐匿，不留痕迹，她重新化作全队最灵敏的预警锚点，将所有脆弱藏于心底，只留极致审慎的戒备。
苏野依旧领路在前，骨骼肌群锁死僵硬，步伐沉稳落地，每一次落脚都精准试探土质虚实，规避沙地陷阱与隐蔽坑洼。他视线死锁雾色深处，瞳孔持续凝缩，视野切割所有阴影死角，指尖始终虚搭在腰间武器柄上，维持着随时可爆发出击的蛰伏姿态。久经沙场的本能让他对人为动静极度敏感，废墟风声、沙砾滚落、枝条震颤，所有自然声响都被他精准过滤，只为捕捉潜藏的敌人踪迹。
身后船员依次跟进，全员躯体紧绷，面色灰败，唇瓣干裂起皮，连日辐射侵蚀与体能透支的疲态尽数刻在肌理之上。众人无人交谈、无人喘息、无人张望，动作机械规整，只剩纯粹的求生前行，在死寂的焦土旷野里，踏出一串单调、枯燥、压抑的脚步声，反复回荡、层层叠加，愈发衬得天地死寂无边。
越往内陆纵深，地貌愈发荒芜狰狞。
原本连片的废墟村落彻底断层，低矮残垣尽数消失，取而代之的是大片硬化的黑色裸岩高地，地表凹凸不平，岩层表面布满炮火轰击的斑驳痕迹，裂痕里塞满碳化粉尘与干涸血垢，踩上去坚硬硌脚，持续刺激足底神经，发麻的钝感不断向上蔓延。雾色愈发暗沉，天光彻底被雾层遮蔽，整片天地压成一片死寂的灰度，没有丝毫生机波动。
空气里的铁腥腐气愈发浓重，混杂着浓重的硝烟余味与辐射焦糊味，死死黏附在鼻腔、咽喉与肺腑之间，每一次呼吸都带着磨砂般的涩痛，反胃闷胀的生理性不适感恒定存续，无从排解。整片疆域的暴戾能量持续暴涨，空气结块厚重，压得人神经发硬、胸腔窒息，每一寸肌肤都处于紧绷戒备的应激状态。
前行二十余分钟，周遭死寂骤然被一道细碎的异动刺破。
不是风声、不是沙响、不是自然落尘。
是刻意压制、却依旧紊乱急促的喘息声，混杂着肢体拖拽沙石的摩擦声，微弱、断续、藏在远处雾层之后，极难捕捉。若是寻常人途经，只会将其误判为风沙异响，转瞬忽略。
苏野脚步骤然顿停。
他双耳微收，视线瞬间锁定左侧前方三百米外的雾霭盲区，眼底凛冽杀意瞬间上浮，厮杀本能彻底拉满。
“前方有人。”
短短三字，冷硬锋利，不带半分多余情绪。
同一瞬间，林小满颅腔又是一阵刺痛。
紊乱破碎的生命气息突兀闯入她的感知网，虚弱、惶恐、濒临溃散，带着浓重的恐惧戾气，与整片天地死寂的暴戾能量格格不入。不是蛰伏野兽的野性凶煞，不是变异生物的嗜血躁动，是纯粹属于人类的精神波动，且为数不止一人。
“四个人。”她语速极快，字句克制精准，气息依旧浅促，“体能濒临耗尽，精神极度恐慌，没有埋伏气场，是溃逃状态。”
陆寻眸底微动，沉黑的眼底掠过一丝极淡的研判光泽。
西陆内陆腹地，除了钢铁城的征伐军队，再无成建制的活人活动。能出现在这片死地、且处于溃逃状态的人，只有一种可能。
他抬手压住队伍，冷硬指令低低落下。
“全员戒备，缓慢靠近。”
一行人即刻收束步伐，阵型微缩，全员器械前置，动作轻缓克制，规避多余声响，稳步朝着异动来源处推进。雾霭遮挡视线，前路模糊未知，无人放松戒备，绝境之中，任何活人都可能是杀机，也可能是唯一情报来源。
三百米距离，转瞬拉近。
厚重雾层缓缓散开盲区，四道狼狈歪斜的人影，彻底暴露在众人视野之中。
四人尽数身着破损严重的黑色制式军服，衣料硬化发黑，沾满血垢、沙尘与碳化碎屑，多处衣料撕裂破损，露出底下布满擦伤、灼伤、辐射溃烂痕迹的皮肤。制式肩章残缺不全，边缘焦黑卷曲，依稀能辨认出钢铁城专属的钢铁纹路徽记，破败却极具辨识度。
是钢铁城的士兵。
四人状态极差，彻底脱离了钢铁城军队的铁血规整，只剩极致的狼狈与溃逃的慌乱。两人腿部带伤，步履歪斜拖沓，伤口渗血早已凝固成黑褐色硬块，粘连衣物皮肉，每一步挪动都带着极致的忍痛滞涩；一人小臂创口外翻，皮肉溃烂发炎，在辐射侵蚀下泛着诡异的暗红；最后一人肩头贯穿伤破损严重，半边身子僵硬无力，只能靠着同伴搀扶勉强站立。
content_en:
;;
The three minute time limit is up.
No redundant prompts, no rest and procrastination.
Lu Xun retracted the fingertips that were supporting Lin Xiaoman's shoulders, and his arms naturally dropped back to his side. His muscles tightened and returned to their original positions, and all the slackness was instantly cleared. The soreness and swelling of the old injury on the lower back still continued to pull, and the low-frequency burning numbness of the cross badge on the chest was firmly entrenched in the chest. The energy oppression of this dead land never weakened, and always covered everyone's bodies. His eyes were dark, and his emotions had completely subsided, leaving only a rigid and calm will to move forward. His lips parted slightly, and the cold and short sentences simply fell to the ground.
"Keep going."
After the words fell, the footsteps moved first.
The group stepped into the thick fog again. The team formation was still compact and alert, and no one relaxed. Lin Xiaoman suppressed the dull pain that remained in his skull, and his breathing gradually returned to shallow and steady. The spiritual perception network was once again fully deployed, and the fine spiritual threads penetrated the thick layer of fog, screening all energy changes and life breaths within a hundred meters radius. The short-lived emotional collapse just now was completely hidden, leaving no trace. She once again turned into the team's most sensitive early warning anchor, hiding all vulnerabilities deep in her heart, leaving only extreme caution.
Su Ye still led the way, his skeletal muscles locked and stiff, and his steps landing steadily. Every time he landed, he accurately tested the soil texture and avoided sand traps and hidden potholes. His gaze was fixed on the depths of the mist, his pupils continued to condense, his field of vision cut through all shadow corners, and his fingertips were always resting on the handle of the weapon at his waist, maintaining a dormant posture ready to attack at any time. His battle-hardened instincts make him extremely sensitive to man-made noises. He filters the wind from ruins, rolling gravel, and trembling branches. All natural sounds are precisely filtered by him, just to capture the traces of hidden enemies.
The crew members followed one after another. Their bodies were tense, their faces were ashen, their lips were chapped and peeled, and the fatigue from days of radiation erosion and physical exhaustion were all etched on their texture. No one was talking, no one was breathing, no one was looking, their movements were mechanical and regular, and only the pure movement forward for survival was left. In the dead and scorched wilderness, a series of monotonous, boring, and depressing footsteps echoed repeatedly and were superimposed layer by layer, making the world more and more endlessly silent.
The farther inland the landscape becomes, the more barren and ferocious it becomes.
The originally contiguous ruined villages were completely cut off, and all the low ruins disappeared. They were replaced by large areas of hardened black bare rock highlands. The surface was uneven, and the surface of the rock formations was covered with mottled traces of artillery bombardment. The cracks were filled with carbonized dust and dried blood. It was hard and harsh when stepped on, and continued to stimulate the nerves in the plantar. The numbness continued to spread upwards. The fog became darker and darker, the skylight was completely obscured by the fog layer, and the entire world was reduced to a dead gray scale without the slightest fluctuation of life.
The irony rotten smell in the air became thicker and thicker, mixed with the heavy aftertaste of gunpowder smoke and the burnt smell of radiation. It clung to the nasal cavity, throat and lungs. Every breath brought a grinding pain, and the physiological discomfort of nausea and bloating persisted and could not be relieved. The violent energy in the entire territory continues to skyrocket, and the air is thick and thick, which makes people's nerves harden, their chests suffocate, and every inch of skin is in a state of tense and alert stress.
After walking forward for more than twenty minutes, the dead silence around them was suddenly pierced by a tiny movement.
Not the sound of wind, not the sound of sand, not the sound of natural falling dust.
It was a deliberately suppressed but still chaotic and rapid breathing sound, mixed with the friction sound of limbs dragging sand and stones. It was weak, intermittent, hidden behind a layer of fog in the distance, and extremely difficult to capture. If ordinary people were passing by, they would simply misjudge it as the unusual noise of wind and sand and ignore it for a moment.
Su Ye's footsteps suddenly stopped.
His ears were slightly closed, and his eyes were instantly locked on the foggy blind spot three hundred meters ahead on the left. The murderous intent in his eyes instantly rose, and his fighting instinct was fully activated.
"There's someone ahead."
Just three words, cold and sharp, without any unnecessary emotion.
At the same moment, Lin Xiaoman felt another stab of pain in his skull.
The chaotic and broken breath of life suddenly broke into her sensory network. She was weak, frightened, and on the verge of collapse, with a strong sense of fear and hostility, which was incompatible with the violent energy of death in the entire world. It is not the wild ferocity of dormant beasts, nor the bloodthirsty restlessness of mutated creatures. It is purely human mental fluctuations, and there are more than one person.
"Four people." She spoke very fast, her words were restrained and precise, and her breath was still shallow. "Physical energy is on the verge of exhaustion, and the spirit is extremely panicked. There is no ambush aura, and it is a state of collapse."
Lu Xun's eyes moved slightly, and a faint glint of judgment flashed across his dark eyes.
In the hinterland of the Western Continent, apart from the expeditionary army in Steel City, there are no organized living activities. There is only one possibility for people who can appear in this dead place and are in a state of panic.
He raised his hand to suppress the team and issued a cold command.
"Everyone is on alert, approach slowly."
The group immediately stopped their steps, their formation shrunk, all their equipment was moved forward, their movements were gentle and restrained, they avoided unnecessary noise, and steadily advanced towards the source of the abnormal movement. The fog blocks the view, the road ahead is unclear and unknown, and no one relaxes their guard. In a desperate situation, any living person may be a murderous intention or the only source of intelligence.
The distance of three hundred meters was shortened in an instant.
The thick layer of fog slowly spread out of the blind spot, and four awkward and crooked figures were completely exposed to everyone's view.
All four of them were wearing heavily damaged black military uniforms. The material was hardened and blackened, and stained with blood, dust, and carbonized debris. The clothing was torn and damaged in many places, revealing skin covered with scratches, burns, and traces of radiation ulcers underneath. The standard shoulder insignia is incomplete, with the edges charred and curled. The exclusive steel pattern emblem of the Steel City can be vaguely recognized. It is dilapidated but highly recognizable.
They are soldiers from Steel City.
The four of them were in extremely poor condition. They were completely separated from the iron-blooded order of the Iron City army, leaving only the ultimate embarrassment and the panic of fleeing. The two men had injuries on their legs, and their steps were sloppy. The blood from the wounds had already solidified into dark brown lumps, adhering to their clothes and flesh. Every step they took was accompanied by extreme pain tolerance.
